summary: Allot Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The press release discloses revenues of $26.4 million, up 14% year-over-year, with SECaaS revenue of $8.7 million and operating income of $1.5 million. Management reaffirmed full-year revenue guidance of $113-117 million. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation. This is a routine earnings announcement with no triggering event for any special-situations category.
